newsitem.title: FINLAND: AKTIA BANK TO OPEN BRANCH OFFICE IN JARVENPAA.
newsitem.headline: AKTIA BANK TO OPEN BRANCH OFFICE IN JARVENPAA.

text.p: Finnish Aktia Bank said in a statement on Monday it had decided to open a new brach office in Jarvenpaa outside Helsinki in early 1997.
It said it already had clients in Jarvenpaa and that the decision was made in agreement with the rest of the savings banking group.
"So far all our new branches have started well and this inspires us to continue expanding," Aktia said.
The bank has earlier announced plans to open a branch office in Tampere in early 1997. It said it now has 62 branches.
